`src/lib/stations.json`: ~45 entries. Seed at least: Berlin Hbf (8011160; 52.5251, 13.3694), Frankfurt(Main) Hbf (8000105; 50.1071, 8.6638), Basel SBB (8500010; 47.5476, 7.5896), Zürich HB (8503000; 47.3779, 8.5403), Hamburg Hbf, München Hbf, Köln Hbf, Stuttgart Hbf, Hannover Hbf, Leipzig Hbf, Dresden Hbf, Nürnberg Hbf, Mannheim Hbf, Karlsruhe Hbf, Freiburg(Breisgau) Hbf, Düsseldorf Hbf, Essen Hbf, Dortmund Hbf, Bremen Hbf, Erfurt Hbf, Fulda, Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe, Würzburg Hbf, Göttingen, Augsburg Hbf, Ulm Hbf, Offenburg, Frankfurt(M) Flughafen Fernbf, Bonn Hbf, Koblenz Hbf, Mainz Hbf, Wolfsburg Hbf, Aachen Hbf, Münster(Westf) Hbf, Heidelberg Hbf, Regensburg Hbf, Bern, Luzern, Basel Bad Bf, Wien Hbf, Salzburg Hbf, Innsbruck Hbf, Amsterdam Centraal, Paris Est, Strasbourg. Spot-check EVA numbers against the DB Timetables output the backend already has (`scripts/db_timetables.py`); coordinates only need city accuracy at the zooms used.

`normaliseName(s)`: lowercase, NFD-strip diacritics (ü→u, also map ß→ss), collapse whitespace, drop parentheses content variants ("Frankfurt (Main) Hbf" ≡ "Frankfurt(Main) Hbf" ≡ "Frankfurt Main Hbf"), strip trailing "Hbf"/"HB"/"Hauptbahnhof" for a second-pass match. Lookup order: evaNumber exact → normalised name exact → normalised name without suffix.

`geo.ts`: `legLine(leg) → [[lon,lat],[lon,lat]]` straight segment (600 km legs; MapLibre projects onto the globe, the curve difference is invisible), `routeBounds(legs)`, `riskColour(p)`: `p < 0.15 → --risk-low`, `< 0.4 → --risk-mid`, else `--risk-high`. Leg colour = the `missProbability` of the transfer at the end of that leg (last leg: its `expectedDelayMinutes` scaled), which is exactly the "chain" story.

## 6. Globe feature

- `useMap.ts`: create `new maplibregl.Map({ container, style: {version:8, sources:{carto:{type:"raster", tiles:[...], tileSize:256, attribution}}, layers:[{id:"bg",type:"background",paint:{"background-color":"#07070c"}},{id:"tiles",type:"raster",source:"carto",paint:{"raster-opacity":0.85}}], projection:{type:"globe"}}, center:[10,50], zoom:1.8, pitch:0, attributionControl:false })`. Clean up with `map.remove()` in the effect return (StrictMode double-mount safe). Import `maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css`.
- Idle: rAF loop nudging `center.lng` by 0.03°/frame while `stage === "idle"` and not reduced-motion; stops on first interaction.
- `useRouteLayers.ts`: one GeoJSON source per journey (`main`, `alt`) with `lineMetrics: true`; per leg a `line` layer filtered by `leg` property, `line-width` 4 (6 in presenter), `line-blur` 0.5, plus a duplicated wider low-opacity layer for glow; `circle` layer for stations (white core, colour ring); `symbol` layer with station names (needs a glyph URL: `https://tiles.openfreemap.org/fonts/{fontstack}/{range}.pbf`; if offline just skip labels, cards carry the names).
- **Animated draw**: keep geometry static, animate the paint property `line-gradient` with `["interpolate",["linear"],["line-progress"],0,colour, t,colour, Math.min(t+0.001,1),"rgba(0,0,0,0)"]` from `t=0→1` over 700 ms per leg, chained leg by leg. Reduced motion: set `t=1` immediately.
- Alternative route: same layers with `line-dasharray [2,2]` and the low-risk colour; toggled by `showAlternative`.
- `camera.ts`: `fitRoute(map, bounds, {padding: {right: rail ? 480 : 24, bottom: sheet ? 320 : 24}, duration: 2200, essential: true})`; `flyToStation(map, station, zoom 9.5, pitch 45)`; `homeGlobe(map)` back to zoom 1.8. All read `useReducedMotion()` and pass `duration: 0` when set.

## 7. Panel features

- `LegCard`: train id large, `from → to`, planned HH:MM–HH:MM, transfer pill "12 min change". Stagger in with `motion` variants (index * 80 ms).
- `LegDelayRow`: same card plus "+8 min · likely 3–20" (echo `predict.py` wording) and a risk bar; `confidence` shown as three dots, `reasoning` under a "why" disclosure (Explained<T> is on screen, satisfying AGENTS rule 8: sources + rationale visible, never presented as calibrated).
- `ChainStrip`: horizontal strip of legs joined by transfer nodes; node width = transferMinutes, shrink animation subtracts expected delay; a broken node turns red with "missed". This is the 0:30 shot visual.
- `FailHeadline`: "Probability your plan fails" + count-up `animate(0, value*100, {duration: 1.2})` to `NN%`; colour by `riskColour`.
- `RecommendationPanel`: verdict badge (`good` / `add-buffer` / `take-alternative`), `advice.value` in large type, buffer minutes, button "Show alternative" → `toggleAlternative` (draws alt route and fits both).
- `SharePanel` (user mode idle): big textarea "Paste what the DB app shared", primary button "Check my plan", secondary "Use the demo journey". `SharePage` for `/share`: read `text ?? title ?? url` from `URLSearchParams`, `history.replaceState` to `/`, dispatch `share(text)` and `runFromText`.
- `OfflineBanner` / seed pill and `InstallHint` (listen `beforeinstallprompt`, show a small "Install" button; also used in the close slide).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Move job inputs and results between this machine and the Nebius bucket over the S3 API.
#
#   bash sync_bucket.sh upload <examples.parquet>     package trip/ and upload data and code
#   bash sync_bucket.sh results <run tag> <local dir> download logs and predictions of a run
#   bash sync_bucket.sh ls                            list the bucket
#
# Credentials come from the repo-root .env: NEBIUS_S3_ENDPOINT, NEBIUS_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and
# NEBIUS_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (a service-account access key; only tenant admins can create one).
# The AWS CLI runs through uvx, so nothing is installed globally.
set -euo pipefail

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
TRIP="$(dirname "$HERE")"
ROOT="$(git -C "$HERE" rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

## 3. pwa-shell

**`static.js` — `createStaticHandler({ dir, indexFile = 'index.html' }) → async (req, res, pathname) => boolean`**
- Path safety: `const file = path.resolve(dir, '.' + path.posix.normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)))`; reject if `!file.startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep) && file !== path.resolve(dir)` → return false.
- `stat` via `fs.promises.stat`; directory → `index.html` inside it. ENOENT → SPA fallback only for `GET`/`HEAD` and only if the request has no file extension (`!path.extname(pathname)`) or `Accept` contains `text/html`; serve `dir/index.html` with 200 (if that is also missing → return false).
- MIME table: `.html text/html; .js/.mjs text/javascript; .css text/css; .json application/json; .webmanifest application/manifest+json; .svg image/svg+xml; .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ico .woff .woff2 .txt .map .wasm`. Unknown → `application/octet-stream`.

## 4. share-parser

**Line tokenizer** (`grammar.js`). Pre-split: `text.split(/\r?\n|\s[–|→]\s/)`, trim, drop blanks. Classify each line by the first matching rule, in this priority order (order matters: a `Dauer 7:54` line contains a time, and a `Richtung Frankfurt(Main) Hbf` train line contains a station):

| # | Token | Regex (case-insensitive) | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | URL | `https?:\/\/\S+` | `{ url, vbid }` (`vbid=([0-9a-f-]{8,})`) |
| 2 | TRANSFER | `(Umstieg|Umsteigezeit|Umsteigen|transfer(?:\s*time)?|change)\D*(\d+)\s*(min)` | `{ minutes }` |
| 3 | SUMMARY | `^(Dauer|Duration|Reisedauer|Fahrtzeit)\b` or `\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[–-]\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}` (two times on one line) | connection boundary |
| 4 | HEADER | `^(Verbindung|Connection|Option)\s*\d+` or `^-{3,}$` | connection boundary |
| 5 | DATE | `(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})` / `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})` | `{ y, m, d }` |
| 6 | STOP | `^(?:(ab|an|dep|arr)\.?\s+)?(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?:\s*Uhr)?(?:\s+(ab|an|dep|arr))?\s+(.+?)(?:\s*(?:Gl\.|Gleis|Platform|Pl\.|Track)\s*\S+)?$` | `{ tag: 'dep'|'arr'|null, hh, mm, station }` |
| 7 | TRAIN | `\b(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})\b` | `{ trainId: "ICE 1005" }` (normalise to one space) |
| 8 | NOISE | anything else | ignored |

**State machine** (`parseConnections(tokens, { now })` → `RawConnection[]`, each `{ legs: RawLeg[], date, complete }`):

States: `IDLE` → `WANT_TRAIN` → `IN_LEG` → `AFTER_ARRIVAL`; context: `pendingTrain`, `cur` (open leg), `conn`, `date`.

| State | Token | Action → next |
|---|---|---|
| any | HEADER / SUMMARY | close `cur` (incomplete if no arrival); push `conn` if it has ≥1 leg; start new conn → IDLE |
| any | DATE | `date = …` |
| any | URL | record on conn (used for vbid fallback if nothing else parses) |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRAIN | `pendingTrain = id` |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | STOP (tag `dep` or untagged) | open leg `{ from, plannedDeparture }`; if `pendingTrain` → `trainId`, → IN_LEG else → WANT_TRAIN. In AFTER_ARRIVAL, if previous leg has no `transferMinutes`, set it to `dep − prevArr` |
| WANT_TRAIN | TRAIN | `cur.trainId` → IN_LEG |
| WANT_TRAIN | STOP tagged `arr` | leg without a train: keep `trainId = 'unknown'` (still complete) → close → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP (tag `arr` or untagged) | `cur.to, plannedArrival` (if < departure, +1 day); push leg → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP tagged `dep` | previous leg has no arrival → mark conn `complete=false`; open new leg → IN_LEG/WANT_TRAIN |
| IN_LEG | TRAIN | intermediate stop list / mismatch: `pendingTrain = id` (do not overwrite `cur.trainId`) |
| AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRANSFER | `legs.at(-1).transferMinutes = minutes` |
| end of input | | close as above |

`pickFirstComplete(conns)`: first conn with ≥1 leg where every leg has `trainId, from, to, plannedDeparture, plannedArrival`; for legs 0..n−2 fill `transferMinutes` from times if missing. If none → `null` → 400 `"No complete connection found in text"` with `details: { connectionsSeen, legsSeen }`.

## 5. delay-prediction

**`connection.js` — port of connection.py (keep function names recognisable)**
```js
export function normalise(probs) {                     // TrainForecast.normalised
  let total = 0; for (const p of probs) total += p;
  if (!(total > 0)) throw new Error('delay distribution has no mass');
  return Float64Array.from(probs, (p) => p / total);
}
// P(A - D <= slack) without building the full convolution:
// np.convolve(a, d[::-1]) index n ↔ offset n-(|d|-1) = i-j, so
// Σ_{i-j<=slack} a[i]d[j] = Σ_i a[i] · P(D >= i - slack)
export function changeProbability(arriving, departing, plannedBuffer, minTransfer) {
  const a = normalise(arriving.probs), d = normalise(departing.probs);
  const slack = Math.floor(plannedBuffer - minTransfer);
  const tailD = new Float64Array(d.length + 1);         // tailD[k] = P(D >= k), tailD[len] = 0
  for (let k = d.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) tailD[k] = tailD[k + 1] + d[k];
  let pMade = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const k = i - slack;                                 // need D >= i - slack
    pMade += a[i] * (k <= 0 ? 1 : k >= d.length ? 0 : tailD[k]);
  }
  return (1 - (arriving.pCancel ?? 0)) * (1 - (departing.pCancel ?? 0)) * pMade;
}
export function journeyProbability(changes, finalArrival = null, arrivalSlack = null) {
  const perChange = changes.map(([arr, dep, buffer, minT]) => changeProbability(arr, dep, buffer, minT));
  let success = perChange.reduce((p, x) => p * x, 1);
  if (finalArrival && arrivalSlack != null) {
    const pmf = normalise(finalArrival.probs);
    let onTime = 0; for (let k = 0; k <= Math.floor(arrivalSlack) && k < pmf.length; k++) onTime += pmf[k];
    success *= (1 - (finalArrival.pCancel ?? 0)) * onTime;
  }
  return { changeProbabilities: perChange, planSuccess: success, planFail: 1 - success };
}
export function point(minutes, size = 1000, pCancel = 0) { const probs = new Float64Array(size); probs[minutes] = 1; return { probs, pCancel }; }
export function quantile(probs, q) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < p.length; k++) { c += p[k]; if (c >= q) return k; } return p.length - 1; }
export const LATE_MINUTES = 6;                            // metrics.LATE_MINUTES
export function onTimeProbability({ probs, pCancel = 0 }) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < LATE_MINUTES && k < p.length; k++) c += p[k]; return c * (1 - pCancel); }
```
Tests port `test_connection.py` exactly: `(point(5),point(0),8,4)→0`, `(3,0)→1`, `(5,2)→1`, `(4,0)→1`; cancellations `0.9*0.8`; journey chain `[ (1,0,6,3),(2,0,6,3) ]` with final `[0.5,0,0,0.5]`, slack 2 → success 0.5; plus a geometric-vs-brute-force O(n·m) double-sum cross-check (replaces the Monte Carlo test, deterministic).

**Backends.** Common shape a backend returns: `{ modelId, legs: [{ trainId, arrival: { probs, pCancel }, departure?: { probs, pCancel }, reasoning, sources, confidence }] }` (departure optional → arrival is used, as `predict.py` does).

`backends/mock.js` — `createMockBackend({ size = 240 })`. Deterministic, no RNG. Per leg: class from `trainId` prefix, hour from `plannedDeparture`, duration in hours.
- median by class: ICE 8, IC/EC/ECE 5, IR/IRE/RE/RB/TGV/RJ/NJ 3, S 2; pCancel ICE/IC 0.02, regional 0.03.
- hour multiplier: 06–09 ×0.9, 15–19 ×1.3, 22–05 ×0.8, else ×1.0; distance: `× (1 + 0.15·durationHours)` (long ICE legs drift more — makes the Berlin leg the story's culprit).
- pmf: geometric with `q = 0.5 ** (1 / (median + 1))` so the median lands exactly on `median`; `probs[k] = (1−q)·q^k`, k < size, renormalised. Departure distribution = same with median × 0.4.
- reasoning: `"Mock prior for ICE at 06:00–09:00 on a 3.6 h leg: typical +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance within 5 min."`, `sources: ['mock: train-class × hour prior v1']`, `confidence: 'low'`, `modelId: 'mock-prior-v1'`.

`backends/http.js` — `createHttpBackend({ url, fetchImpl = fetch, timeoutMs = 8000 })`: `POST url` with the Journey as JSON, `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)`, non-2xx → throw; validate each leg has `arrival.probs` array; `confidence: 'medium'`; `modelId` from response else `'OpenTSLM db-trip-delay (unversioned)'`. This is the contract the Python side implements later (a tiny stdlib `http.server` around `model.predict_distribution`).

**Service**
```js
export function createPredictionService({ env = process.env, backend, fetchImpl = fetch } = {}) {
  const mock = createMockBackend();
  const chosen = backend ?? ((env.PREDICT_BACKEND || (env.PREDICT_URL ? 'http' : 'mock')) === 'http'
      ? createHttpBackend({ url: env.PREDICT_URL, fetchImpl, timeoutMs: Number(env.PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS || 8000) }) : mock);
  const minTransfer = Number(env.MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES || 5);
  return {
    async forecast(journey) { validate(journey); try { return await chosen.forecast(journey); }
      catch (e) { const f = await mock.forecast(journey); f.fallbackFrom = e.message; return f; } },   // http → mock fallback, noted in reasoning
    chain(journey, forecasts) → Prediction,        // pure, reused by recommendation
    async predict(journey) { return this.chain(journey, await this.forecast(journey)); },
  };
}
```
`chain`: for `i < legs.length − 1`: `buffer = legs[i].transferMinutes ?? minutesBetween(legs[i].plannedArrival, legs[i+1].plannedDeparture)`; `miss_i = 1 − changeProbability(f[i].arrival, f[i+1].departure ?? f[i+1].arrival, buffer, minTransfer)`; last leg `miss = 0` with reasoning "final leg — nothing to miss". `expectedDelayMinutes.value = quantile(arrival.probs, 0.5)`, reasoning like predict.py's headline (`about +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance of arriving on time`) + backend reasoning. `missProbability.reasoning`: `"12 min planned at Frankfurt(Main) Hbf, 5 min needed to change → 7 min slack; P(ICE 1005 arrival delay − ICE 75 departure delay > 7) = 46%, cancellation 2% + 2%."` `planFailProbability = journeyProbability(changes).planFail` with reasoning `"1 − (1−0.46)(1−0.58) = 0.77; changes treated as independent (optimistic when one disruption hits both trains)"`. `sources` = union of leg sources; `confidence` = backend's (`'low'` for mock). `modelId` from backend. Validation: `legs` non-empty array, each leg has `trainId`, `plannedDeparture`, `plannedArrival` → else 400.

# Backend implementation plan — error404.ai (10 h)

## 0. What I found in the repo that shapes the plan

- `/Users/akshatkhair/Documents/Projects/temporal_ai_error404.ai/app/backend/src/server.js` — the request loop is 15 lines: `router.match` → JSON 404 → `readJson` → handler → `sendJson`. There is no OPTIONS/HEAD handling; `Router.match` filters by exact method, so a `HEAD` or `OPTIONS` request currently gets the JSON 404. `sendJson` uses `res.writeHead(status, {...})`, which Node merges with headers previously set via `res.setHeader`, so CORS headers can be set up front without touching `sendJson`.
- Feature pattern to copy verbatim: `createXService(ctx)` factory + `registerRoutes(router, ctx)` that returns the service (`app/backend/src/features/training-jobs/routes/training-jobs.js:83-98`). Errors carry `.status` on a plain `Error` (line 15) rather than importing `HttpError` — keep that: a feature module importing `HttpError` from `../../../server.js` creates an ESM import cycle (server.js imports the feature). It works, but it's a foot-gun; use `Object.assign(new Error(msg), { status: 400 })` instead.
- Tests: `node:test` + `node:assert/strict`, exercise handlers via `new Router()` + `router.match(...).handler({ params, query, body })` (training-jobs.test.js:151-163). Fake `fetch` via `fetchImpl` injection (line 107). Reuse both idioms.
- Python math to port: `connection.py` — `change_probability` = P(A − D ≤ floor(buffer − minTransfer)) × (1−pc_a)(1−pc_d); `journey_probability` = product of change probs; `plan_fail = 1 − success`. `predict.py` shows the traveller summary to mimic (median / p10–p90 / `on_time = CDF(LATE_MINUTES−1 = 5) × (1−p_cancel)`), and that the connecting train's departure delay is approximated by its arrival delay. Model distributions are length 1000 (`MAX_MINUTES = 999`) — port must accept any length.
- `scripts/db_timetables.py` — `station/{pattern}` returns `<station name=".." eva=".."/>` elements; parse with a regex, no XML lib needed.
- Node on this machine is v26.8.2 (`process.loadEnvFile`, `AbortSignal.timeout`, `Intl` `longOffset` all available). `.gitignore` already whitelists `.env.example`.
- `team-setup/scripts/smoke.sh` runs `npm --prefix app/backend test` and can take `SMOKE_HEALTH_URL`; set it to `/api/health` at the end.
- Governance: `owners.md` lists share-parser / pwa-shell as frontend features; backend folders with the same names are the sanctioned "spans layers" case. `lat/lon` on `Station` needs one appended line in `team-setup/state/decisions.md` (AGENTS.md rule 4) — flag for a human, don't self-approve.

## 3. pwa-shell

**`static.js` — `createStaticHandler({ dir, indexFile = 'index.html' }) → async (req, res, pathname) => boolean`**
- Path safety: `const file = path.resolve(dir, '.' + path.posix.normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)))`; reject if `!file.startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep) && file !== path.resolve(dir)` → return false.
- `stat` via `fs.promises.stat`; directory → `index.html` inside it. ENOENT → SPA fallback only for `GET`/`HEAD` and only if the request has no file extension (`!path.extname(pathname)`) or `Accept` contains `text/html`; serve `dir/index.html` with 200 (if that is also missing → return false).
- MIME table: `.html text/html; .js/.mjs text/javascript; .css text/css; .json application/json; .webmanifest application/manifest+json; .svg image/svg+xml; .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ico .woff .woff2 .txt .map .wasm`. Unknown → `application/octet-stream`.
- Cache headers: `sw.js`, `index.html`, `manifest.webmanifest` → `Cache-Control: no-cache` (+ `Service-Worker-Allowed: /` on sw.js); anything under `/assets/` (Vite content-hashed) → `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; else `no-cache`.
- Streaming: `res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type', 'Content-Length': st.size, 'Cache-Control', 'Last-Modified' })`; for HEAD `res.end()`; else `fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)` with `stream.on('error', () => res.destroy())`.
- Returns `true` whenever it wrote a response.

## 4. share-parser

**Line tokenizer** (`grammar.js`). Pre-split: `text.split(/\r?\n|\s[–|→]\s/)`, trim, drop blanks. Classify each line by the first matching rule, in this priority order (order matters: a `Dauer 7:54` line contains a time, and a `Richtung Frankfurt(Main) Hbf` train line contains a station):

| # | Token | Regex (case-insensitive) | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | URL | `https?:\/\/\S+` | `{ url, vbid }` (`vbid=([0-9a-f-]{8,})`) |
| 2 | TRANSFER | `(Umstieg|Umsteigezeit|Umsteigen|transfer(?:\s*time)?|change)\D*(\d+)\s*(min)` | `{ minutes }` |
| 3 | SUMMARY | `^(Dauer|Duration|Reisedauer|Fahrtzeit)\b` or `\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[–-]\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}` (two times on one line) | connection boundary |
| 4 | HEADER | `^(Verbindung|Connection|Option)\s*\d+` or `^-{3,}$` | connection boundary |
| 5 | DATE | `(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})` / `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})` | `{ y, m, d }` |
| 6 | STOP | `^(?:(ab|an|dep|arr)\.?\s+)?(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?:\s*Uhr)?(?:\s+(ab|an|dep|arr))?\s+(.+?)(?:\s*(?:Gl\.|Gleis|Platform|Pl\.|Track)\s*\S+)?$` | `{ tag: 'dep'|'arr'|null, hh, mm, station }` |
| 7 | TRAIN | `\b(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})\b` | `{ trainId: "ICE 1005" }` (normalise to one space) |
| 8 | NOISE | anything else | ignored |

**State machine** (`parseConnections(tokens, { now })` → `RawConnection[]`, each `{ legs: RawLeg[], date, complete }`):

States: `IDLE` → `WANT_TRAIN` → `IN_LEG` → `AFTER_ARRIVAL`; context: `pendingTrain`, `cur` (open leg), `conn`, `date`.

| State | Token | Action → next |
|---|---|---|
| any | HEADER / SUMMARY | close `cur` (incomplete if no arrival); push `conn` if it has ≥1 leg; start new conn → IDLE |
| any | DATE | `date = …` |
| any | URL | record on conn (used for vbid fallback if nothing else parses) |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRAIN | `pendingTrain = id` |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | STOP (tag `dep` or untagged) | open leg `{ from, plannedDeparture }`; if `pendingTrain` → `trainId`, → IN_LEG else → WANT_TRAIN. In AFTER_ARRIVAL, if previous leg has no `transferMinutes`, set it to `dep − prevArr` |
| WANT_TRAIN | TRAIN | `cur.trainId` → IN_LEG |
| WANT_TRAIN | STOP tagged `arr` | leg without a train: keep `trainId = 'unknown'` (still complete) → close → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP (tag `arr` or untagged) | `cur.to, plannedArrival` (if < departure, +1 day); push leg → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP tagged `dep` | previous leg has no arrival → mark conn `complete=false`; open new leg → IN_LEG/WANT_TRAIN |
| IN_LEG | TRAIN | intermediate stop list / mismatch: `pendingTrain = id` (do not overwrite `cur.trainId`) |
| AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRANSFER | `legs.at(-1).transferMinutes = minutes` |
| end of input | | close as above |

`pickFirstComplete(conns)`: first conn with ≥1 leg where every leg has `trainId, from, to, plannedDeparture, plannedArrival`; for legs 0..n−2 fill `transferMinutes` from times if missing. If none → `null` → 400 `"No complete connection found in text"` with `details: { connectionsSeen, legsSeen }`.

Time → ISO: `berlinIso(date, hh, mm)` builds `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00±HH:MM` where the offset comes from `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Europe/Berlin', timeZoneName: 'longOffset' })` ("GMT+02:00"). Date defaults to `now` (injectable for tests). Journey `id = 'jrn_' + sha1(legs.map(l => trainId+dep+from.eva).join('|')).slice(0, 10)`, `source: 'db-share'`.

**Stations** (`stations.js`): `normaliseName(s)` → lowercase, `ä→ae ö→oe ü→ue ß→ss`, strip diacritics (`normalize('NFD')`), `hauptbahnhof→hbf`, collapse punctuation/spaces, drop `(main)`/`(breisgau)` only as a last-resort second pass. `createStationResolver({ stations, env, fetchImpl = fetch })` → `resolve(name)`: exact normalised match → prefix/contains match → if `env.DB_CLIENT_ID && env.DB_API_KEY` call `GET {BASE}/station/{encodeURIComponent(name)}` with `DB-Client-Id`/`DB-Api-Key`/`Accept: application/xml`, parse `/<station[^>]*\bname="([^"]*)"[^>]*\beva="(\d+)"/g`, cache in a `Map`, 4 s timeout → else `{ evaNumber: '', name }` (still a valid `Station`). `stations.json` (~25 entries, `{ name, evaNumber, lat, lon, aliases[] }`): Berlin Hbf 8011160, Berlin Südkreuz 8011113, Hamburg Hbf 8002549, Hannover Hbf 8000152, Leipzig Hbf 8010205, Erfurt Hbf 8010101, Fulda 8000115, Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe 8003200, Frankfurt(Main) Hbf 8000105, Frankfurt(M) Flughafen Fernbf 8070003, Mannheim Hbf 8000244, Karlsruhe Hbf 8000191, Offenburg 8000290, Freiburg(Breisgau) Hbf 8000107, Basel Bad Bf 8000026, Basel SBB 8500010, Zürich HB 8503000, Bern 8507000, Olten 8500218, Stuttgart Hbf 8000096, München Hbf 8000261, Nürnberg Hbf 8000284, Würzburg Hbf 8000260, Köln Hbf 8000207, Düsseldorf Hbf 8000085, Dresden Hbf 8010085. The four demo EVAs are given; spot-check the rest with `python3 scripts/db_timetables.py "<name>"` when creds are present (the API fallback covers misses anyway).

**vbid resolver** (`vbid.js`, only if `env.BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER === '1'`): `GET https://www.bahn.de/web/api/angebote/verbindung/{vbid}` (the endpoint the open-source db-vendo-client uses; unofficial, may be bot-blocked), `Accept: application/json`, 5 s timeout. Anything unexpected → 422 `"Share text only contains a bahn.de link; paste the connection details instead"` with `details: { vbid, resolverEnabled }`. Flag off → 422 immediately.

## 5. delay-prediction

**`connection.js` — port of connection.py (keep function names recognisable)**
```js
export function normalise(probs) {                     // TrainForecast.normalised
  let total = 0; for (const p of probs) total += p;
  if (!(total > 0)) throw new Error('delay distribution has no mass');
  return Float64Array.from(probs, (p) => p / total);
}
// P(A - D <= slack) without building the full convolution:
// np.convolve(a, d[::-1]) index n ↔ offset n-(|d|-1) = i-j, so
// Σ_{i-j<=slack} a[i]d[j] = Σ_i a[i] · P(D >= i - slack)
export function changeProbability(arriving, departing, plannedBuffer, minTransfer) {
  const a = normalise(arriving.probs), d = normalise(departing.probs);
  const slack = Math.floor(plannedBuffer - minTransfer);
  const tailD = new Float64Array(d.length + 1);         // tailD[k] = P(D >= k), tailD[len] = 0
  for (let k = d.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) tailD[k] = tailD[k + 1] + d[k];
  let pMade = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const k = i - slack;                                 // need D >= i - slack
    pMade += a[i] * (k <= 0 ? 1 : k >= d.length ? 0 : tailD[k]);
  }
  return (1 - (arriving.pCancel ?? 0)) * (1 - (departing.pCancel ?? 0)) * pMade;
}
export function journeyProbability(changes, finalArrival = null, arrivalSlack = null) {
  const perChange = changes.map(([arr, dep, buffer, minT]) => changeProbability(arr, dep, buffer, minT));
  let success = perChange.reduce((p, x) => p * x, 1);
  if (finalArrival && arrivalSlack != null) {
    const pmf = normalise(finalArrival.probs);
    let onTime = 0; for (let k = 0; k <= Math.floor(arrivalSlack) && k < pmf.length; k++) onTime += pmf[k];
    success *= (1 - (finalArrival.pCancel ?? 0)) * onTime;
  }
  return { changeProbabilities: perChange, planSuccess: success, planFail: 1 - success };
}
export function point(minutes, size = 1000, pCancel = 0) { const probs = new Float64Array(size); probs[minutes] = 1; return { probs, pCancel }; }
export function quantile(probs, q) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < p.length; k++) { c += p[k]; if (c >= q) return k; } return p.length - 1; }
export const LATE_MINUTES = 6;                            // metrics.LATE_MINUTES
export function onTimeProbability({ probs, pCancel = 0 }) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < LATE_MINUTES && k < p.length; k++) c += p[k]; return c * (1 - pCancel); }
```

- hour multiplier: 06–09 ×0.9, 15–19 ×1.3, 22–05 ×0.8, else ×1.0; distance: `× (1 + 0.15·durationHours)` (long ICE legs drift more — makes the Berlin leg the story's culprit).
- pmf: geometric with `q = 0.5 ** (1 / (median + 1))` so the median lands exactly on `median`; `probs[k] = (1−q)·q^k`, k < size, renormalised. Departure distribution = same with median × 0.4.
- reasoning: `"Mock prior for ICE at 06:00–09:00 on a 3.6 h leg: typical +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance within 5 min."`, `sources: ['mock: train-class × hour prior v1']`, `confidence: 'low'`, `modelId: 'mock-prior-v1'`.

export function createPredictionService({ env = process.env, backend, fetchImpl = fetch } = {}) {
  const mock = createMockBackend();
  const chosen = backend ?? ((env.PREDICT_BACKEND || (env.PREDICT_URL ? 'http' : 'mock')) === 'http'
      ? createHttpBackend({ url: env.PREDICT_URL, fetchImpl, timeoutMs: Number(env.PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS || 8000) }) : mock);
  const minTransfer = Number(env.MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES || 5);
  return {
    async forecast(journey) { validate(journey); try { return await chosen.forecast(journey); }
      catch (e) { const f = await mock.forecast(journey); f.fallbackFrom = e.message; return f; } },   // http → mock fallback, noted in reasoning
    chain(journey, forecasts) → Prediction,        // pure, reused by recommendation
    async predict(journey) { return this.chain(journey, await this.forecast(journey)); },
  };
}
```

## 3. pwa-shell

**`static.js` — `createStaticHandler({ dir, indexFile = 'index.html' }) → async (req, res, pathname) => boolean`**
- Path safety: `const file = path.resolve(dir, '.' + path.posix.normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)))`; reject if `!file.startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep) && file !== path.resolve(dir)` → return false.
- `stat` via `fs.promises.stat`; directory → `index.html` inside it. ENOENT → SPA fallback only for `GET`/`HEAD` and only if the request has no file extension (`!path.extname(pathname)`) or `Accept` contains `text/html`; serve `dir/index.html` with 200 (if that is also missing → return false).
- MIME table: `.html text/html; .js/.mjs text/javascript; .css text/css; .json application/json; .webmanifest application/manifest+json; .svg image/svg+xml; .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ico .woff .woff2 .txt .map .wasm`. Unknown → `application/octet-stream`.
- Cache headers: `sw.js`, `index.html`, `manifest.webmanifest` → `Cache-Control: no-cache` (+ `Service-Worker-Allowed: /` on sw.js); anything under `/assets/` (Vite content-hashed) → `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; else `no-cache`.
- Streaming: `res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type', 'Content-Length': st.size, 'Cache-Control', 'Last-Modified' })`; for HEAD `res.end()`; else `fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)` with `stream.on('error', () => res.destroy())`.
- Returns `true` whenever it wrote a response.

## 4. share-parser

**Line tokenizer** (`grammar.js`). Pre-split: `text.split(/\r?\n|\s[–|→]\s/)`, trim, drop blanks. Classify each line by the first matching rule, in this priority order (order matters: a `Dauer 7:54` line contains a time, and a `Richtung Frankfurt(Main) Hbf` train line contains a station):

| # | Token | Regex (case-insensitive) | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | URL | `https?:\/\/\S+` | `{ url, vbid }` (`vbid=([0-9a-f-]{8,})`) |
| 2 | TRANSFER | `(Umstieg|Umsteigezeit|Umsteigen|transfer(?:\s*time)?|change)\D*(\d+)\s*(min)` | `{ minutes }` |
| 3 | SUMMARY | `^(Dauer|Duration|Reisedauer|Fahrtzeit)\b` or `\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[–-]\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}` (two times on one line) | connection boundary |
| 4 | HEADER | `^(Verbindung|Connection|Option)\s*\d+` or `^-{3,}$` | connection boundary |
| 5 | DATE | `(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})` / `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})` | `{ y, m, d }` |
| 6 | STOP | `^(?:(ab|an|dep|arr)\.?\s+)?(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?:\s*Uhr)?(?:\s+(ab|an|dep|arr))?\s+(.+?)(?:\s*(?:Gl\.|Gleis|Platform|Pl\.|Track)\s*\S+)?$` | `{ tag: 'dep'|'arr'|null, hh, mm, station }` |
| 7 | TRAIN | `\b(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})\b` | `{ trainId: "ICE 1005" }` (normalise to one space) |
| 8 | NOISE | anything else | ignored |

**State machine** (`parseConnections(tokens, { now })` → `RawConnection[]`, each `{ legs: RawLeg[], date, complete }`):

States: `IDLE` → `WANT_TRAIN` → `IN_LEG` → `AFTER_ARRIVAL`; context: `pendingTrain`, `cur` (open leg), `conn`, `date`.

| State | Token | Action → next |
|---|---|---|
| any | HEADER / SUMMARY | close `cur` (incomplete if no arrival); push `conn` if it has ≥1 leg; start new conn → IDLE |
| any | DATE | `date = …` |
| any | URL | record on conn (used for vbid fallback if nothing else parses) |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRAIN | `pendingTrain = id` |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | STOP (tag `dep` or untagged) | open leg `{ from, plannedDeparture }`; if `pendingTrain` → `trainId`, → IN_LEG else → WANT_TRAIN. In AFTER_ARRIVAL, if previous leg has no `transferMinutes`, set it to `dep − prevArr` |
| WANT_TRAIN | TRAIN | `cur.trainId` → IN_LEG |
| WANT_TRAIN | STOP tagged `arr` | leg without a train: keep `trainId = 'unknown'` (still complete) → close → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP (tag `arr` or untagged) | `cur.to, plannedArrival` (if < departure, +1 day); push leg → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP tagged `dep` | previous leg has no arrival → mark conn `complete=false`; open new leg → IN_LEG/WANT_TRAIN |
| IN_LEG | TRAIN | intermediate stop list / mismatch: `pendingTrain = id` (do not overwrite `cur.trainId`) |
| AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRANSFER | `legs.at(-1).transferMinutes = minutes` |
| end of input | | close as above |

`pickFirstComplete(conns)`: first conn with ≥1 leg where every leg has `trainId, from, to, plannedDeparture, plannedArrival`; for legs 0..n−2 fill `transferMinutes` from times if missing. If none → `null` → 400 `"No complete connection found in text"` with `details: { connectionsSeen, legsSeen }`.

Time → ISO: `berlinIso(date, hh, mm)` builds `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00±HH:MM` where the offset comes from `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Europe/Berlin', timeZoneName: 'longOffset' })` ("GMT+02:00"). Date defaults to `now` (injectable for tests). Journey `id = 'jrn_' + sha1(legs.map(l => trainId+dep+from.eva).join('|')).slice(0, 10)`, `source: 'db-share'`.

**Stations** (`stations.js`): `normaliseName(s)` → lowercase, `ä→ae ö→oe ü→ue ß→ss`, strip diacritics (`normalize('NFD')`), `hauptbahnhof→hbf`, collapse punctuation/spaces, drop `(main)`/`(breisgau)` only as a last-resort second pass. `createStationResolver({ stations, env, fetchImpl = fetch })` → `resolve(name)`: exact normalised match → prefix/contains match → if `env.DB_CLIENT_ID && env.DB_API_KEY` call `GET {BASE}/station/{encodeURIComponent(name)}` with `DB-Client-Id`/`DB-Api-Key`/`Accept: application/xml`, parse `/<station[^>]*\bname="([^"]*)"[^>]*\beva="(\d+)"/g`, cache in a `Map`, 4 s timeout → else `{ evaNumber: '', name }` (still a valid `Station`). `stations.json` (~25 entries, `{ name, evaNumber, lat, lon, aliases[] }`): Berlin Hbf 8011160, Berlin Südkreuz 8011113, Hamburg Hbf 8002549, Hannover Hbf 8000152, Leipzig Hbf 8010205, Erfurt Hbf 8010101, Fulda 8000115, Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe 8003200, Frankfurt(Main) Hbf 8000105, Frankfurt(M) Flughafen Fernbf 8070003, Mannheim Hbf 8000244, Karlsruhe Hbf 8000191, Offenburg 8000290, Freiburg(Breisgau) Hbf 8000107, Basel Bad Bf 8000026, Basel SBB 8500010, Zürich HB 8503000, Bern 8507000, Olten 8500218, Stuttgart Hbf 8000096, München Hbf 8000261, Nürnberg Hbf 8000284, Würzburg Hbf 8000260, Köln Hbf 8000207, Düsseldorf Hbf 8000085, Dresden Hbf 8010085. The four demo EVAs are given; spot-check the rest with `python3 scripts/db_timetables.py "<name>"` when creds are present (the API fallback covers misses anyway).

**vbid resolver** (`vbid.js`, only if `env.BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER === '1'`): `GET https://www.bahn.de/web/api/angebote/verbindung/{vbid}` (the endpoint the open-source db-vendo-client uses; unofficial, may be bot-blocked), `Accept: application/json`, 5 s timeout. Map `verbindungen[0].verbindungsAbschnitte[]` where `verkehrsmittel.typ !== 'WALK'` → legs: `abfahrtsOrt/abfahrtsOrtExtId`, `ankunftsOrt/ankunftsOrtExtId`, `abfahrtsZeitpunkt/ankunftsZeitpunkt`, `verkehrsmittel.name`. ## 5. delay-prediction

**`connection.js` — port of connection.py (keep function names recognisable)**
```js
export function normalise(probs) {                     // TrainForecast.normalised
  let total = 0; for (const p of probs) total += p;
  if (!(total > 0)) throw new Error('delay distribution has no mass');
  return Float64Array.from(probs, (p) => p / total);
}
// P(A - D <= slack) without building the full convolution:
// np.convolve(a, d[::-1]) index n ↔ offset n-(|d|-1) = i-j, so
// Σ_{i-j<=slack} a[i]d[j] = Σ_i a[i] · P(D >= i - slack)
export function changeProbability(arriving, departing, plannedBuffer, minTransfer) {
  const a = normalise(arriving.probs), d = normalise(departing.probs);
  const slack = Math.floor(plannedBuffer - minTransfer);
  const tailD = new Float64Array(d.length + 1);         // tailD[k] = P(D >= k), tailD[len] = 0
  for (let k = d.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) tailD[k] = tailD[k + 1] + d[k];
  let pMade = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const k = i - slack;                                 // need D >= i - slack
    pMade += a[i] * (k <= 0 ? 1 : k >= d.length ? 0 : tailD[k]);
  }
  return (1 - (arriving.pCancel ?? 0)) * (1 - (departing.pCancel ?? 0)) * pMade;
}
export function journeyProbability(changes, finalArrival = null, arrivalSlack = null) {
  const perChange = changes.map(([arr, dep, buffer, minT]) => changeProbability(arr, dep, buffer, minT));
  let success = perChange.reduce((p, x) => p * x, 1);
  if (finalArrival && arrivalSlack != null) {
    const pmf = normalise(finalArrival.probs);
    let onTime = 0; for (let k = 0; k <= Math.floor(arrivalSlack) && k < pmf.length; k++) onTime += pmf[k];
    success *= (1 - (finalArrival.pCancel ?? 0)) * onTime;
  }
  return { changeProbabilities: perChange, planSuccess: success, planFail: 1 - success };
}
export function point(minutes, size = 1000, pCancel = 0) { const probs = new Float64Array(size); probs[minutes] = 1; return { probs, pCancel }; }
export function quantile(probs, q) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < p.length; k++) { c += p[k]; if (c >= q) return k; } return p.length - 1; }
export const LATE_MINUTES = 6;                            // metrics.LATE_MINUTES
export function onTimeProbability({ probs, pCancel = 0 }) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < LATE_MINUTES && k < p.length; k++) c += p[k]; return c * (1 - pCancel); }
```
Tests port `test_connection.py` exactly: `(point(5),point(0),8,4)→0`, `(3,0)→1`, `(5,2)→1`, `(4,0)→1`; cancellations `0.9*0.8`; journey chain `[ (1,0,6,3),(2,0,6,3) ]` with final `[0.5,0,0,0.5]`, slack 2 → success 0.5; plus a geometric-vs-brute-force O(n·m) double-sum cross-check (replaces the Monte Carlo test, deterministic).

**Backends.** Common shape a backend returns: `{ modelId, legs: [{ trainId, arrival: { probs, pCancel }, departure?: { probs, pCancel }, reasoning, sources, confidence }] }` (departure optional → arrival is used, as `predict.py` does).

`backends/mock.js` — `createMockBackend({ size = 240 })`. Deterministic, no RNG. Per leg: class from `trainId` prefix, hour from `plannedDeparture`, duration in hours.
- median by class: ICE 8, IC/EC/ECE 5, IR/IRE/RE/RB/TGV/RJ/NJ 3, S 2; pCancel ICE/IC 0.02, regional 0.03.
- hour multiplier: 06–09 ×0.9, 15–19 ×1.3, 22–05 ×0.8, else ×1.0; distance: `× (1 + 0.15·durationHours)` (long ICE legs drift more — makes the Berlin leg the story's culprit).
- pmf: geometric with `q = 0.5 ** (1 / (median + 1))` so the median lands exactly on `median`; `probs[k] = (1−q)·q^k`, k < size, renormalised. Departure distribution = same with median × 0.4.
- reasoning: `"Mock prior for ICE at 06:00–09:00 on a 3.6 h leg: typical +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance within 5 min."`, `sources: ['mock: train-class × hour prior v1']`, `confidence: 'low'`, `modelId: 'mock-prior-v1'`.

`backends/http.js` — `createHttpBackend({ url, fetchImpl = fetch, timeoutMs = 8000 })`: `POST url` with the Journey as JSON, `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)`, non-2xx → throw; validate each leg has `arrival.probs` array; `confidence: 'medium'`; `modelId` from response else `'OpenTSLM db-trip-delay (unversioned)'`. This is the contract the Python side implements later (a tiny stdlib `http.server` around `model.predict_distribution`).

**Service**
```js
export function createPredictionService({ env = process.env, backend, fetchImpl = fetch } = {}) {
  const mock = createMockBackend();
  const chosen = backend ?? ((env.PREDICT_BACKEND || (env.PREDICT_URL ? 'http' : 'mock')) === 'http'
      ? createHttpBackend({ url: env.PREDICT_URL, fetchImpl, timeoutMs: Number(env.PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS || 8000) }) : mock);
  const minTransfer = Number(env.MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES || 5);
  return {
    async forecast(journey) { validate(journey); try { return await chosen.forecast(journey); }
      catch (e) { const f = await mock.forecast(journey); f.fallbackFrom = e.message; return f; } },   // http → mock fallback, noted in reasoning
    chain(journey, forecasts) → Prediction,        // pure, reused by recommendation
    async predict(journey) { return this.chain(journey, await this.forecast(journey)); },
  };
}
```
`chain`: for `i < legs.length − 1`: `buffer = legs[i].transferMinutes ?? minutesBetween(legs[i].plannedArrival, legs[i+1].plannedDeparture)`; `miss_i = 1 − changeProbability(f[i].arrival, f[i+1].departure ?? f[i+1].arrival, buffer, minTransfer)`; last leg `miss = 0` with reasoning "final leg — nothing to miss". `expectedDelayMinutes.value = quantile(arrival.probs, 0.5)`, reasoning like predict.py's headline (`about +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance of arriving on time`) + backend reasoning. `missProbability.reasoning`: `"12 min planned at Frankfurt(Main) Hbf, 5 min needed to change → 7 min slack; P(ICE 1005 arrival delay − ICE 75 departure delay > 7) = 46%, cancellation 2% + 2%."` `planFailProbability = journeyProbability(changes).planFail` with reasoning `"1 − (1−0.46)(1−0.58) = 0.77; changes treated as independent (optimistic when one disruption hits both trains)"`. `sources` = union of leg sources; `confidence` = backend's (`'low'` for mock). `modelId` from backend. Validation: `legs` non-empty array, each leg has `trainId`, `plannedDeparture`, `plannedArrival` → else 400.

Route: `router.post('/api/predict', ({ body }) => svc.predict(body))`; `registerRoutes` returns `svc`.

Rules (`GOOD_THRESHOLD = 0.15`, `MAX_BUFFER = 30`, `BUFFER_STEP = 5`):
1. `pf = prediction.planFailProbability.value`; `pf < 0.15` → `verdict 'good'`.
2. `weakest = argmax_i legs[i].missProbability.value` over `i < last`. Get forecasts once: `f = await predict.forecast(journey)`. For `b` in 5..30 step 5: `j2 = withTransfer(journey, weakest, +b)` (shift legs `> weakest` later? No — simplest and honest: only bump `transferMinutes[weakest]`, meaning "take the next train at that station"), `pf2 = predict.chain(j2, f).planFailProbability.value`; first `b` with `pf2 < 0.15` → `verdict 'add-buffer'`, `bufferMinutes: b`.
3. Else `verdict 'take-alternative'`: `alternative = alternatives[routeKey(journey)]` (key `firstFromEva->lastToEva`, e.g. `8011160->8503000`) or synthesized: shift legs `0..weakest` earlier by 25 min (`trainId` kept, `source: 'manual'`, `id: journey.id + '-alt'`). **`static.js` — `createStaticHandler({ dir, indexFile = 'index.html' }) → async (req, res, pathname) => boolean`**
- Path safety: `const file = path.resolve(dir, '.' + path.posix.normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)))`; reject if `!file.startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep) && file !== path.resolve(dir)` → return false.
- `stat` via `fs.promises.stat`; directory → `index.html` inside it. ENOENT → SPA fallback only for `GET`/`HEAD` and only if the request has no file extension (`!path.extname(pathname)`) or `Accept` contains `text/html`; serve `dir/index.html` with 200 (if that is also missing → return false).
- MIME table: `.html text/html; .js/.mjs text/javascript; .css text/css; .json application/json; .webmanifest application/manifest+json; .svg image/svg+xml; .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ico .woff .woff2 .txt .map .wasm`. Unknown → `application/octet-stream`.

- Streaming: `res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type', 'Content-Length': st.size, 'Cache-Control', 'Last-Modified' })`; for HEAD `res.end()`; else `fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)` with `stream.on('error', () => res.destroy())`.
- Returns `true` whenever it wrote a response.

**Line tokenizer** (`grammar.js`). Pre-split: `text.split(/\r?\n|\s[–|→]\s/)`, trim, drop blanks. Classify each line by the first matching rule, in this priority order (order matters: a `Dauer 7:54` line contains a time, and a `Richtung Frankfurt(Main) Hbf` train line contains a station):

| # | Token | Regex (case-insensitive) | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | URL | `https?:\/\/\S+` | `{ url, vbid }` (`vbid=([0-9a-f-]{8,})`) |
| 2 | TRANSFER | `(Umstieg|Umsteigezeit|Umsteigen|transfer(?:\s*time)?|change)\D*(\d+)\s*(min)` | `{ minutes }` |
| 3 | SUMMARY | `^(Dauer|Duration|Reisedauer|Fahrtzeit)\b` or `\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[–-]\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}` (two times on one line) | connection boundary |
| 4 | HEADER | `^(Verbindung|Connection|Option)\s*\d+` or `^-{3,}$` | connection boundary |
| 5 | DATE | `(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})` / `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})` | `{ y, m, d }` |
| 6 | STOP | `^(?:(ab|an|dep|arr)\.?\s+)?(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?:\s*Uhr)?(?:\s+(ab|an|dep|arr))?\s+(.+?)(?:\s*(?:Gl\.|Gleis|Platform|Pl\.|Track)\s*\S+)?$` | `{ tag: 'dep'|'arr'|null, hh, mm, station }` |
| 7 | TRAIN | `\b(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})\b` | `{ trainId: "ICE 1005" }` (normalise to one space) |
| 8 | NOISE | anything else | ignored |

**State machine** (`parseConnections(tokens, { now })` → `RawConnection[]`, each `{ legs: RawLeg[], date, complete }`):

States: `IDLE` → `WANT_TRAIN` → `IN_LEG` → `AFTER_ARRIVAL`; context: `pendingTrain`, `cur` (open leg), `conn`, `date`.

| State | Token | Action → next |
|---|---|---|
| any | HEADER / SUMMARY | close `cur` (incomplete if no arrival); push `conn` if it has ≥1 leg; start new conn → IDLE |
| any | DATE | `date = …` |
| any | URL | record on conn (used for vbid fallback if nothing else parses) |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRAIN | `pendingTrain = id` |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | STOP (tag `dep` or untagged) | open leg `{ from, plannedDeparture }`; if `pendingTrain` → `trainId`, → IN_LEG else → WANT_TRAIN. In AFTER_ARRIVAL, if previous leg has no `transferMinutes`, set it to `dep − prevArr` |
| WANT_TRAIN | TRAIN | `cur.trainId` → IN_LEG |
| WANT_TRAIN | STOP tagged `arr` | leg without a train: keep `trainId = 'unknown'` (still complete) → close → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP (tag `arr` or untagged) | `cur.to, plannedArrival` (if < departure, +1 day); push leg → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP tagged `dep` | previous leg has no arrival → mark conn `complete=false`; open new leg → IN_LEG/WANT_TRAIN |
| IN_LEG | TRAIN | intermediate stop list / mismatch: `pendingTrain = id` (do not overwrite `cur.trainId`) |
| AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRANSFER | `legs.at(-1).transferMinutes = minutes` |
| end of input | | close as above |

`pickFirstComplete(conns)`: first conn with ≥1 leg where every leg has `trainId, from, to, plannedDeparture, plannedArrival`; for legs 0..n−2 fill `transferMinutes` from times if missing. If none → `null` → 400 `"No complete connection found in text"` with `details: { connectionsSeen, legsSeen }`.

```js
export function normalise(probs) {                     // TrainForecast.normalised
  let total = 0; for (const p of probs) total += p;
  if (!(total > 0)) throw new Error('delay distribution has no mass');
  return Float64Array.from(probs, (p) => p / total);
}
// P(A - D <= slack) without building the full convolution:
// np.convolve(a, d[::-1]) index n ↔ offset n-(|d|-1) = i-j, so
// Σ_{i-j<=slack} a[i]d[j] = Σ_i a[i] · P(D >= i - slack)
export function changeProbability(arriving, departing, plannedBuffer, minTransfer) {
  const a = normalise(arriving.probs), d = normalise(departing.probs);
  const slack = Math.floor(plannedBuffer - minTransfer);
  const tailD = new Float64Array(d.length + 1);         // tailD[k] = P(D >= k), tailD[len] = 0
  for (let k = d.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) tailD[k] = tailD[k + 1] + d[k];
  let pMade = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const k = i - slack;                                 // need D >= i - slack
    pMade += a[i] * (k <= 0 ? 1 : k >= d.length ? 0 : tailD[k]);
  }
  return (1 - (arriving.pCancel ?? 0)) * (1 - (departing.pCancel ?? 0)) * pMade;
}
export function journeyProbability(changes, finalArrival = null, arrivalSlack = null) {
  const perChange = changes.map(([arr, dep, buffer, minT]) => changeProbability(arr, dep, buffer, minT));
  let success = perChange.reduce((p, x) => p * x, 1);
  if (finalArrival && arrivalSlack != null) {
    const pmf = normalise(finalArrival.probs);
    let onTime = 0; for (let k = 0; k <= Math.floor(arrivalSlack) && k < pmf.length; k++) onTime += pmf[k];
    success *= (1 - (finalArrival.pCancel ?? 0)) * onTime;
  }
  return { changeProbabilities: perChange, planSuccess: success, planFail: 1 - success };
}
export function point(minutes, size = 1000, pCancel = 0) { const probs = new Float64Array(size); probs[minutes] = 1; return { probs, pCancel }; }
export function quantile(probs, q) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < p.length; k++) { c += p[k]; if (c >= q) return k; } return p.length - 1; }
export const LATE_MINUTES = 6;                            // metrics.LATE_MINUTES
export function onTimeProbability({ probs, pCancel = 0 }) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < LATE_MINUTES && k < p.length; k++) c += p[k]; return c * (1 - pCancel); }
```

      if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return sendJson(res, 404, { error: `No route for ${req.method} ${url.pathname}` });
      // 4) static file, then SPA fallback (index.html), handled inside serveStatic
      if (await serveStatic(req, res, url.pathname)) return;
      // 5) no dist built / not found
      return sendJson(res, 404, { error: `No route for ${req.method} ${url.pathname}`, hint: 'build the PWA: npm --prefix app/frontend run build (or set STATIC_DIR)' });
    }
    ...unchanged try/catch...
```
Ordering rule: **route → /api 404 → static file → SPA index.html → 404**. HEAD requests never match the Router (method filter) and drop straight into `serveStatic`, which handles them. Also extend the startup `console.log` list with the four new endpoints. Note for the frontend: if Vite's dev server proxies `/api` to 8000 (`server.proxy`), `CORS_ORIGIN` is unnecessary; it's only for calling 8000 directly from 5173.

## 3. pwa-shell

**`static.js` — `createStaticHandler({ dir, indexFile = 'index.html' }) → async (req, res, pathname) => boolean`**
- Path safety: `const file = path.resolve(dir, '.' + path.posix.normalize(decodeURIComponent(pathname)))`; reject if `!file.startsWith(path.resolve(dir) + path.sep) && file !== path.resolve(dir)` → return false.
- `stat` via `fs.promises.stat`; directory → `index.html` inside it. ENOENT → SPA fallback only for `GET`/`HEAD` and only if the request has no file extension (`!path.extname(pathname)`) or `Accept` contains `text/html`; serve `dir/index.html` with 200 (if that is also missing → return false).
- MIME table: `.html text/html; .js/.mjs text/javascript; .css text/css; .json application/json; .webmanifest application/manifest+json; .svg image/svg+xml; .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .ico .woff .woff2 .txt .map .wasm`. Unknown → `application/octet-stream`.
- Cache headers: `sw.js`, `index.html`, `manifest.webmanifest` → `Cache-Control: no-cache` (+ `Service-Worker-Allowed: /` on sw.js); anything under `/assets/` (Vite content-hashed) → `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; else `no-cache`.
- Streaming: `res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type', 'Content-Length': st.size, 'Cache-Control', 'Last-Modified' })`; for HEAD `res.end()`; else `fs.createReadStream(file).pipe(res)` with `stream.on('error', () => res.destroy())`.
- Returns `true` whenever it wrote a response.

## 4. share-parser

**Line tokenizer** (`grammar.js`). Pre-split: `text.split(/\r?\n|\s[–|→]\s/)`, trim, drop blanks. Classify each line by the first matching rule, in this priority order (order matters: a `Dauer 7:54` line contains a time, and a `Richtung Frankfurt(Main) Hbf` train line contains a station):

| # | Token | Regex (case-insensitive) | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | URL | `https?:\/\/\S+` | `{ url, vbid }` (`vbid=([0-9a-f-]{8,})`) |
| 2 | TRANSFER | `(Umstieg|Umsteigezeit|Umsteigen|transfer(?:\s*time)?|change)\D*(\d+)\s*(min)` | `{ minutes }` |
| 3 | SUMMARY | `^(Dauer|Duration|Reisedauer|Fahrtzeit)\b` or `\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*[–-]\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}` (two times on one line) | connection boundary |
| 4 | HEADER | `^(Verbindung|Connection|Option)\s*\d+` or `^-{3,}$` | connection boundary |
| 5 | DATE | `(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})` / `(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})` | `{ y, m, d }` |
| 6 | STOP | `^(?:(ab|an|dep|arr)\.?\s+)?(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?:\s*Uhr)?(?:\s+(ab|an|dep|arr))?\s+(.+?)(?:\s*(?:Gl\.|Gleis|Platform|Pl\.|Track)\s*\S+)?$` | `{ tag: 'dep'|'arr'|null, hh, mm, station }` |
| 7 | TRAIN | `\b(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})\b` | `{ trainId: "ICE 1005" }` (normalise to one space) |
| 8 | NOISE | anything else | ignored |

**State machine** (`parseConnections(tokens, { now })` → `RawConnection[]`, each `{ legs: RawLeg[], date, complete }`):

States: `IDLE` → `WANT_TRAIN` → `IN_LEG` → `AFTER_ARRIVAL`; context: `pendingTrain`, `cur` (open leg), `conn`, `date`.

| State | Token | Action → next |
|---|---|---|
| any | HEADER / SUMMARY | close `cur` (incomplete if no arrival); push `conn` if it has ≥1 leg; start new conn → IDLE |
| any | DATE | `date = …` |
| any | URL | record on conn (used for vbid fallback if nothing else parses) |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRAIN | `pendingTrain = id` |
| IDLE / AFTER_ARRIVAL | STOP (tag `dep` or untagged) | open leg `{ from, plannedDeparture }`; if `pendingTrain` → `trainId`, → IN_LEG else → WANT_TRAIN. In AFTER_ARRIVAL, if previous leg has no `transferMinutes`, set it to `dep − prevArr` |
| WANT_TRAIN | TRAIN | `cur.trainId` → IN_LEG |
| WANT_TRAIN | STOP tagged `arr` | leg without a train: keep `trainId = 'unknown'` (still complete) → close → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP (tag `arr` or untagged) | `cur.to, plannedArrival` (if < departure, +1 day); push leg → AFTER_ARRIVAL |
| IN_LEG | STOP tagged `dep` | previous leg has no arrival → mark conn `complete=false`; open new leg → IN_LEG/WANT_TRAIN |
| IN_LEG | TRAIN | intermediate stop list / mismatch: `pendingTrain = id` (do not overwrite `cur.trainId`) |
| AFTER_ARRIVAL | TRANSFER | `legs.at(-1).transferMinutes = minutes` |
| end of input | | close as above |

`pickFirstComplete(conns)`: first conn with ≥1 leg where every leg has `trainId, from, to, plannedDeparture, plannedArrival`; for legs 0..n−2 fill `transferMinutes` from times if missing. If none → `null` → 400 `"No complete connection found in text"` with `details: { connectionsSeen, legsSeen }`.

Time → ISO: `berlinIso(date, hh, mm)` builds `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00±HH:MM` where the offset comes from `new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Europe/Berlin', timeZoneName: 'longOffset' })` ("GMT+02:00"). Date defaults to `now` (injectable for tests). Journey `id = 'jrn_' + sha1(legs.map(l => trainId+dep+from.eva).join('|')).slice(0, 10)`, `source: 'db-share'`.

**Stations** (`stations.js`): `normaliseName(s)` → lowercase, `ä→ae ö→oe ü→ue ß→ss`, strip diacritics (`normalize('NFD')`), `hauptbahnhof→hbf`, collapse punctuation/spaces, drop `(main)`/`(breisgau)` only as a last-resort second pass. `createStationResolver({ stations, env, fetchImpl = fetch })` → `resolve(name)`: exact normalised match → prefix/contains match → if `env.DB_CLIENT_ID && env.DB_API_KEY` call `GET {BASE}/station/{encodeURIComponent(name)}` with `DB-Client-Id`/`DB-Api-Key`/`Accept: application/xml`, parse `/<station[^>]*\bname="([^"]*)"[^>]*\beva="(\d+)"/g`, cache in a `Map`, 4 s timeout → else `{ evaNumber: '', name }` (still a valid `Station`). `stations.json` (~25 entries, `{ name, evaNumber, lat, lon, aliases[] }`): Berlin Hbf 8011160, Berlin Südkreuz 8011113, Hamburg Hbf 8002549, Hannover Hbf 8000152, Leipzig Hbf 8010205, Erfurt Hbf 8010101, Fulda 8000115, Kassel-Wilhelmshöhe 8003200, Frankfurt(Main) Hbf 8000105, Frankfurt(M) Flughafen Fernbf 8070003, Mannheim Hbf 8000244, Karlsruhe Hbf 8000191, Offenburg 8000290, Freiburg(Breisgau) Hbf 8000107, Basel Bad Bf 8000026, Basel SBB 8500010, Zürich HB 8503000, Bern 8507000, Olten 8500218, Stuttgart Hbf 8000096, München Hbf 8000261, Nürnberg Hbf 8000284, Würzburg Hbf 8000260, Köln Hbf 8000207, Düsseldorf Hbf 8000085, Dresden Hbf 8010085. The four demo EVAs are given; spot-check the rest with `python3 scripts/db_timetables.py "<name>"` when creds are present (the API fallback covers misses anyway).

**vbid resolver** (`vbid.js`, only if `env.BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER === '1'`): `GET https://www.bahn.de/web/api/angebote/verbindung/{vbid}` (the endpoint the open-source db-vendo-client uses; unofficial, may be bot-blocked), `Accept: application/json`, 5 s timeout. ## 5. delay-prediction

**`connection.js` — port of connection.py (keep function names recognisable)**
```js
export function normalise(probs) {                     // TrainForecast.normalised
  let total = 0; for (const p of probs) total += p;
  if (!(total > 0)) throw new Error('delay distribution has no mass');
  return Float64Array.from(probs, (p) => p / total);
}
// P(A - D <= slack) without building the full convolution:
// np.convolve(a, d[::-1]) index n ↔ offset n-(|d|-1) = i-j, so
// Σ_{i-j<=slack} a[i]d[j] = Σ_i a[i] · P(D >= i - slack)
export function changeProbability(arriving, departing, plannedBuffer, minTransfer) {
  const a = normalise(arriving.probs), d = normalise(departing.probs);
  const slack = Math.floor(plannedBuffer - minTransfer);
  const tailD = new Float64Array(d.length + 1);         // tailD[k] = P(D >= k), tailD[len] = 0
  for (let k = d.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) tailD[k] = tailD[k + 1] + d[k];
  let pMade = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const k = i - slack;                                 // need D >= i - slack
    pMade += a[i] * (k <= 0 ? 1 : k >= d.length ? 0 : tailD[k]);
  }
  return (1 - (arriving.pCancel ?? 0)) * (1 - (departing.pCancel ?? 0)) * pMade;
}
export function journeyProbability(changes, finalArrival = null, arrivalSlack = null) {
  const perChange = changes.map(([arr, dep, buffer, minT]) => changeProbability(arr, dep, buffer, minT));
  let success = perChange.reduce((p, x) => p * x, 1);
  if (finalArrival && arrivalSlack != null) {
    const pmf = normalise(finalArrival.probs);
    let onTime = 0; for (let k = 0; k <= Math.floor(arrivalSlack) && k < pmf.length; k++) onTime += pmf[k];
    success *= (1 - (finalArrival.pCancel ?? 0)) * onTime;
  }
  return { changeProbabilities: perChange, planSuccess: success, planFail: 1 - success };
}
export function point(minutes, size = 1000, pCancel = 0) { const probs = new Float64Array(size); probs[minutes] = 1; return { probs, pCancel }; }
export function quantile(probs, q) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < p.length; k++) { c += p[k]; if (c >= q) return k; } return p.length - 1; }
export const LATE_MINUTES = 6;                            // metrics.LATE_MINUTES
export function onTimeProbability({ probs, pCancel = 0 }) { const p = normalise(probs); let c = 0; for (let k = 0; k < LATE_MINUTES && k < p.length; k++) c += p[k]; return c * (1 - pCancel); }
```
Tests port `test_connection.py` exactly: `(point(5),point(0),8,4)→0`, `(3,0)→1`, `(5,2)→1`, `(4,0)→1`; cancellations `0.9*0.8`; journey chain `[ (1,0,6,3),(2,0,6,3) ]` with final `[0.5,0,0,0.5]`, slack 2 → success 0.5; plus a geometric-vs-brute-force O(n·m) double-sum cross-check (replaces the Monte Carlo test, deterministic).

**Backends.** Common shape a backend returns: `{ modelId, legs: [{ trainId, arrival: { probs, pCancel }, departure?: { probs, pCancel }, reasoning, sources, confidence }] }` (departure optional → arrival is used, as `predict.py` does).

`backends/mock.js` — `createMockBackend({ size = 240 })`. Deterministic, no RNG. Per leg: class from `trainId` prefix, hour from `plannedDeparture`, duration in hours.
- median by class: ICE 8, IC/EC/ECE 5, IR/IRE/RE/RB/TGV/RJ/NJ 3, S 2; pCancel ICE/IC 0.02, regional 0.03.
- hour multiplier: 06–09 ×0.9, 15–19 ×1.3, 22–05 ×0.8, else ×1.0; distance: `× (1 + 0.15·durationHours)` (long ICE legs drift more — makes the Berlin leg the story's culprit).
- pmf: geometric with `q = 0.5 ** (1 / (median + 1))` so the median lands exactly on `median`; `probs[k] = (1−q)·q^k`, k < size, renormalised. Departure distribution = same with median × 0.4.
- reasoning: `"Mock prior for ICE at 06:00–09:00 on a 3.6 h leg: typical +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance within 5 min."`, `sources: ['mock: train-class × hour prior v1']`, `confidence: 'low'`, `modelId: 'mock-prior-v1'`.

`backends/http.js` — `createHttpBackend({ url, fetchImpl = fetch, timeoutMs = 8000 })`: `POST url` with the Journey as JSON, `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)`, non-2xx → throw; validate each leg has `arrival.probs` array; `confidence: 'medium'`; `modelId` from response else `'OpenTSLM db-trip-delay (unversioned)'`. This is the contract the Python side implements later (a tiny stdlib `http.server` around `model.predict_distribution`).

**Service**
```js
export function createPredictionService({ env = process.env, backend, fetchImpl = fetch } = {}) {
  const mock = createMockBackend();
  const chosen = backend ?? ((env.PREDICT_BACKEND || (env.PREDICT_URL ? 'http' : 'mock')) === 'http'
      ? createHttpBackend({ url: env.PREDICT_URL, fetchImpl, timeoutMs: Number(env.PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS || 8000) }) : mock);
  const minTransfer = Number(env.MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES || 5);
  return {
    async forecast(journey) { validate(journey); try { return await chosen.forecast(journey); }
      catch (e) { const f = await mock.forecast(journey); f.fallbackFrom = e.message; return f; } },   // http → mock fallback, noted in reasoning
    chain(journey, forecasts) → Prediction,        // pure, reused by recommendation
    async predict(journey) { return this.chain(journey, await this.forecast(journey)); },
  };
}
```
`chain`: for `i < legs.length − 1`: `buffer = legs[i].transferMinutes ?? minutesBetween(legs[i].plannedArrival, legs[i+1].plannedDeparture)`; `miss_i = 1 − changeProbability(f[i].arrival, f[i+1].departure ?? f[i+1].arrival, buffer, minTransfer)`; last leg `miss = 0` with reasoning "final leg — nothing to miss". `expectedDelayMinutes.value = quantile(arrival.probs, 0.5)`, reasoning like predict.py's headline (`about +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance of arriving on time`) + backend reasoning. `missProbability.reasoning`: `"12 min planned at Frankfurt(Main) Hbf, 5 min needed to change → 7 min slack; P(ICE 1005 arrival delay − ICE 75 departure delay > 7) = 46%, cancellation 2% + 2%."` `planFailProbability = journeyProbability(changes).planFail` with reasoning `"1 − (1−0.46)(1−0.58) = 0.77; changes treated as independent (optimistic when one disruption hits both trains)"`. `sources` = union of leg sources; `confidence` = backend's (`'low'` for mock). `modelId` from backend. Validation: `legs` non-empty array, each leg has `trainId`, `plannedDeparture`, `plannedArrival` → else 400.

Route: `router.post('/api/predict', ({ body }) => svc.predict(body))`; `registerRoutes` returns `svc`.

Rules (`GOOD_THRESHOLD = 0.15`, `MAX_BUFFER = 30`, `BUFFER_STEP = 5`):
1. `pf = prediction.planFailProbability.value`; `pf < 0.15` → `verdict 'good'`.
2. `weakest = argmax_i legs[i].missProbability.value` over `i < last`. Get forecasts once: `f = await predict.forecast(journey)`. For `b` in 5..30 step 5: `j2 = withTransfer(journey, weakest, +b)` (shift legs `> weakest` later? No — simplest and honest: only bump `transferMinutes[weakest]`, meaning "take the next train at that station"), `pf2 = predict.chain(j2, f).planFailProbability.value`; first `b` with `pf2 < 0.15` → `verdict 'add-buffer'`, `bufferMinutes: b`.
3. Else `verdict 'take-alternative'`: `alternative = alternatives[routeKey(journey)]` (key `firstFromEva->lastToEva`, e.g. `8011160->8503000`) or synthesized: shift legs `0..weakest` earlier by 25 min (`trainId` kept, `source: 'manual'`, `id: journey.id + '-alt'`).   To München Hbf

Canned path when no predict service injected (sanctioned mock).

**Env/docs**: append to `.env.example` (commented): `CORS_ORIGIN`, `STATIC_DIR`, `PREDICT_URL`, `PREDICT_BACKEND`, `PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES`, `BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER` (PORT already exists). Feature READMEs state endpoint + demo shot. Update `app/backend/README.md`.

Mirror config from `team-setup/board/web/` (`package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `components.json`, `index.html`, `src/index.css`, `src/lib/utils.ts`, `src/components/ui/{button,card}.tsx` — import `cn` from `@/lib/utils`). Do NOT edit the board.

# error404.ai — PWA + API + globe demo platform

## Context

Hackathon "Temporal AI" (EHL Zurich). Submission 2026-09-13 10:00 UTC; it is now ~22:30 UTC on the 12th, so ~10 h of build time.
Product: share a Deutsche Bahn connection from the DB app into our PWA → per-leg delay prediction → chained "Probability your plan fails: NN%" → plain-language advice. The ML side (`app/agents`, Jonas) has a trained OpenTSLM model but no serving path. `app/backend` has only Nebius training-job routes. `app/frontend` is an empty placeholder. Nothing connects the halves, and the pitch will be presented **directly from the app** on a projector.

User's brief: web + installable app, minimalistic, super interactive, a **real map** that zooms from Earth into the route, usable as the presentation itself. Decisions already taken with the user:

- Globe: **MapLibre GL JS with `projection: 'globe'`**, free raster tiles (Carto dark, no key), service worker caches tiles seen during rehearsal.
- Higgsfield: **assets only, ≤ 20 credits** (icons + one backdrop). The Higgsfield website builder is rejected (video-scrub shaped, ~100 credits/film, no PWA/share-target support). Record as a decision.
- Share text: real DB Navigator (int.bahn.de, English) sample supplied by the user:
  ```
  Nürnberg Hbf → München Hbf
  Sun 13.09.2026
  RB16 (59143)
  To München Hbf
  From 04:34 Nürnberg Hbf, Platform 5 C-F
  To 07:25 München Hbf, Platform 21
  View journey: https://int.bahn.de/en/buchung/start?vbid=e6285f4d-...
  ```
  Parser grammar is built around this format (plus a German variant and multi-leg repetition).
- Seed route: user asked to pick it from the Nebius bucket data. Bucket `error404-db-route` (606 objects, ~579 MB, created tonight) exists but no S3 keys are in `.env`, so listing was not possible. **Assumption: Berlin Hbf → Frankfurt(Main) Hbf → Basel SBB → Zürich HB (ICE/ICE/IC)** as default. The model is trained on all ~5,200 stations, so any route works. The seed lives in ONE fixture file per layer, so swapping is a 5-minute job. Ask the user to run `! bash app/agents/src/features/db_delay/trip/nebius/sync_bucket.sh ls` after adding S3 keys, or to name the route.

Governance: the contract is DRAFT (code against it, mock what's missing). `owners.md` is blank — claim `app/frontend`, `app/backend` product features for Akshat. Optional `lat`/`lon` on `Station` is an additive contract change → append a proposed decision line, do not self-approve. Never commit unless asked.

## Architecture (target)

```
DB app share ──(GET /share?text=)──▶ PWA (Vite+React, app/frontend/dist)
                                        │ same origin (SW + share_target need it)
                                        ▼

   /api/journeys/parse  share-parser   (grammar + stations.json + optional DB Timetables lookup)
   /api/predict         delay-prediction (mock prior | PREDICT_URL→Python; JS port of connection.py chains legs)
   /api/recommend       recommendation (rules + alternative fixture)
   /api/seed/demo       pwa-shell      (seed journey, offline fallback)
Phone demo over HTTPS: cloudflared quick tunnel → localhost:8000
```

## Work plan

### Phase A — Backend (mocks first, ~1 h to unblock frontend; ~4.5 h total)

Pattern to copy: `app/backend/src/features/training-jobs/routes/training-jobs.js` (`createXService(ctx)` + `registerRoutes(router, ctx)` returning the service; errors as `Object.assign(new Error(msg), {status})`, not `HttpError` import to avoid an ESM cycle). Tests: `node:test`, drive handlers via `new Router()` + `router.match(...)`, like `training-jobs.test.js`.

**`app/backend/src/server.js`** (modify)
- Health: return `{ ok: true, status: 'ok', service, time }` (additive; contract wants `ok`).
- Before routing: if `env.CORS_ORIGIN` set → `Access-Control-*` headers; `OPTIONS` → 204. Router has no `options()`.
- Order: route match → `/api/*` JSON 404 → static file → SPA `index.html` fallback → 404 with hint.
- Register the four new features; pass the prediction service into recommendation (DI).

**`features/pwa-shell/`**: `static.js` (`createStaticHandler({dir})`: path-traversal guard, MIME table incl. `.webmanifest → application/manifest+json`, `Cache-Control: no-cache` for `index.html`/`sw.js`/manifest, `immutable` for `/assets/*`, HEAD support, streams via `fs.createReadStream`; SPA fallback for extension-less GETs). `routes/pwa-shell.js`: `GET /api/seed/demo` from `fixtures/seed-journey.json` (3 legs, EVAs 8011160/8000105/8500010/8503000, transfers 12 & 9 min, lat/lon on stations, times on 2026-09-13 +02:00). **`features/share-parser/`**: `grammar.js` line tokenizer + state machine. Token rules (priority order): URL (`vbid=`), TRANSFER (`Umstieg|transfer|change … N min`), SUMMARY/HEADER boundaries (`Verbindung N`, `Duration`, `A → B` header line), DATE (`13.09.2026`, `2026-09-13`, with weekday prefix), STOP (`^(From|To|Ab|An|dep|arr)?\s*(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s+(.+?)(,\s*(Platform|Gleis|Gl\.)\s*\S+.*)?$` → tag dep/arr from `From/Ab` vs `To/An`), TRAIN (`^(ICE|IC|EC|ECE|IR|IRE|RE|RB|S|TGV|RJ|RJX|NJ|FEX|MEX)\s?(\d{1,5})(\s*\((\d+)\))?` → `trainId "RB 16"`, keep number), "To <dest>" without time = direction line (noise). Multi-leg: repeated TRAIN/From/To blocks; `transferMinutes` = next dep − prev arr when no TRANSFER token. Multiple connections: pick first complete. `stations.js`: `normaliseName` (ä→ae, ß→ss, NFD strip, `Hauptbahnhof→Hbf`, collapse spaces/parens), lookup in `fixtures/stations.json` (~45 DE/CH/AT hubs with eva/lat/lon/aliases), then DB Timetables `station/{pattern}` if `DB_CLIENT_ID`/`DB_API_KEY` set (regex over XML, 4 s timeout), else `{evaNumber:'', name}`. `vbid.js` behind `BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER=1` (best-effort, else 422 with hint). Fixtures: the user's real sample, a German variant, a 3-leg Berlin→Zürich text, a two-connections text, URL-only. Times → ISO with Europe/Berlin offset via `Intl` `longOffset`.

**`features/delay-prediction/`**: `connection.js` = exact JS port of `app/agents/src/features/db_delay/trip/connection.py` (`changeProbability` via tail-sum instead of convolution, `journeyProbability`, `point`, `quantile`, `onTimeProbability`, `LATE_MINUTES = 6`) with the ported `test_connection.py` cases. `backends/mock.js`: deterministic geometric pmf per leg; median by class (ICE 8, IC/EC 5, regional 3, S 2) × hour multiplier × `(1 + 0.15·durationHours)`; pCancel 0.02/0.03; `modelId 'mock-prior-v1'`, confidence `low`. `backends/http.js`: `POST PREDICT_URL` with the Journey, `AbortSignal.timeout`, falls back to mock and notes it in `sources`. Service: `forecast(journey)`, pure `chain(journey, forecasts) → Prediction` (per transfer: `miss = 1 − changeProbability(arr_i, dep_{i+1} ?? arr_{i+1}, buffer, MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES=5)`; last leg miss 0; `planFail` from `journeyProbability`), `Explained` strings mimic `predict.py` wording ("about +8 min, likely 1 to 27 min, 41% chance of arriving on time"). 400 on bad body.

**`features/recommendation/`**: rules `pf < 0.15 → good`; else find weakest transfer, search buffer 5..30 step 5 via `predict.chain` → `add-buffer` + `bufferMinutes`; else `take-alternative` with `fixtures/alternatives.json` (seed route, 50 min earlier, +25 min at both transfers, same arrival) or synthesized shift. Weather-forecast advice copy ("Storm warning: 77% chance you miss a connection, worst at Frankfurt… Leave 50 min earlier on ICE 1001…"). Canned path when no predict service injected (sanctioned mock).

**Env/docs**: append to `.env.example` (commented): `CORS_ORIGIN`, `STATIC_DIR`, `PREDICT_URL`, `PREDICT_BACKEND`, `PREDICT_TIMEOUT_MS`, `MIN_TRANSFER_MINUTES`, `BAHN_VBID_RESOLVER` (PORT already exists). Feature READMEs state endpoint + demo shot. Update `app/backend/README.md`.

# error404.ai — the user-facing app that is also the pitch

## Context

Hackathon "Temporal AI" (EHL Zurich). Submission 2026-09-13 10:00 UTC; ~10 h left.
Product: a traveller shares a Deutsche Bahn connection from the DB app (or pastes it, or builds it from → to) into our web app / installable PWA. The app shows the journey on a real 3D globe that zooms from Earth to the route, predicts each train's delay, chains them into **"Probability your plan fails: NN%"**, and gives plain advice ("leave 50 min earlier on ICE 1001"). Users interact with it directly. **The team presents by using the app live on a projector** — the same screens, the same flow, no separate slide mode. The only presenting aids are a large-type "stage" layout and keyboard shortcuts to advance the real flow.

State of the repo: `app/frontend` is an empty placeholder; `app/backend` only has Nebius training routes; the ML model (`app/agents`) has no serving path. The contract is DRAFT (code against it, mock what is missing). `owners.md` is blank → claim frontend + the four backend product features for Akshat.

Decisions taken with the user:
- **MapLibre GL JS `projection: 'globe'`**, free Carto dark raster tiles (no key); SW caches tiles seen in rehearsal.
- **Higgsfield: assets only, ≤ 20 credits** (icons, one backdrop). Website builder rejected (video-scrub product, ~100 credits/film, no PWA/share-target).
- Real DB Navigator share sample (English, int.bahn.de):
  ```
  Nürnberg Hbf → München Hbf
  Sun 13.09.2026
  RB16 (59143)
  To München Hbf
  From 04:34 Nürnberg Hbf, Platform 5 C-F
  To 07:25 München Hbf, Platform 21
  View journey: https://int.bahn.de/en/buchung/start?vbid=e6285f4d-...
  ```
- Seed route: user wants it picked from the Nebius bucket data. Bucket `error404-db-route` (606 objects, ~579 MB, created tonight) exists but `.env` has no S3 keys, so I could not list it. **Assumption: Berlin Hbf → Frankfurt(Main) Hbf → Basel SBB → Zürich HB** as default; it lives in one fixture per layer (5-minute swap). The model is trained on all stations, so any route works. Ask user to run `! bash app/agents/src/features/db_delay/trip/nebius/sync_bucket.sh ls` once S3 keys are in `.env`, or to name the route.

## What the user sees (single-page app, `app/frontend`)

Full-bleed dark globe, glass panel overlay (right rail ≥ 1024 px, bottom sheet on phone). One flow, four screens, all interactive:

1. **Start** — globe slowly spinning over Europe. Panel: "Will my plan hold?" with three ways in: *paste* what the DB app shared (textarea), *build* a journey (from → to station search over `stations.json`, date/time, legs auto-suggested from a fixture or the DB Timetables API if creds exist), or *try the demo journey*. Web-share-target (`/share?text=`) lands here with the text pre-filled and auto-runs.
2. **Journey** — globe flies from space to the route; legs draw one by one with station pins; cards per leg (train, from → to, planned times, transfer pill). Tap a leg card ⇄ camera flies to that leg; tap a pin ⇄ card highlights. Drag/zoom the globe freely.
3. **Forecast** — legs recolour by risk (green/amber/red); each card gains "+8 min · likely 1–27"; a chain strip shows transfer nodes shrinking; the breaking transfer gets a fly-to; headline counts up to **NN%**. "Why?" disclosure on every number shows `reasoning` + `sources` + confidence (never presented as calibrated). A **buffer slider** ("if I had +N min at Frankfurt…") re-chains live in the browser using the ported connection math — the interactive "what-if".
4. **Advice** — verdict badge + weather-style advice; "Show alternative" draws the earlier connection dashed and fits both; "Compare" toggles between them; "Share result" (Web Share API) and "Install app" prompt.
   Plus two small in-app panels reachable from a footer/menu, used during the pitch: **Proof** (our model vs GPT/Opus baseline, inline SVG bars from `public/proof.json`, PNG fallback) and **About** (the umbrella line, install icon).

**Stage mode** (`?stage=1` or key `S`): same app, bigger type (`html[data-stage]`), progress dots, and keys → / ← that advance the real flow (start → demo journey → forecast → advice → proof → about) and Esc to leave. `F` fullscreen, `M` toggles motion. Works with the backend down (bundled seed fixtures).

The only presenting aids are a large-type "stage" layout and keyboard shortcuts to advance the real flow.

State of the repo: `app/frontend` is an empty placeholder; `app/backend` only has Nebius training routes; the ML model (`app/agents`) has no serving path. - Real DB Navigator share sample (English, int.bahn.de):
  ```

  Sun 13.09.2026
  RB16 (59143)
  To München Hbf
  From 04:34 Nürnberg Hbf, Platform 5 C-F
  To 07:25 München Hbf, Platform 21
  View journey: https://int.bahn.de/en/buchung/start?vbid=e6285f4d-...
  ```
- Seed route: user wants it picked from the Nebius bucket data. Bucket `error404-db-route` (606 objects, ~579 MB, created tonight) exists but `.env` has no S3 keys, so I could not list it. **Assumption: Berlin Hbf → Frankfurt(Main) Hbf → Basel SBB → Zürich HB** as default; it lives in one fixture per layer (5-minute swap).
